note: Oritavancin is available only as an intravenous (IV) infusion solution and is NOT available in oral pill form in the United States
availability_note: Oritavancin (Orbactiv) is exclusively manufactured as an intravenous infusion and has no oral pill variants. It is used to treat acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections (ABSSSI) caused by susceptible gram-positive bacteria and must be administered by healthcare professionals in clinical settings.
